which quoted figures for the adhesion of mortar joints or the expansion of different materials due to the penetration of moisture, based on observations drawn from earlier projects.

The expertise was hybrid, not an exterior intelligence applied to the world, but another artifactual body. If one adds to this Willcock’s view that the older system of basin irrigation was more sophisticated than the barrage and reservoir that replaced it, the conclusion that follows is that in some ways, rather than applying knowledge to the world, the engineering work took it away. British engineers were taught things by the dam and carried this knowledge into scientific journals and irrigation manuals, but the farmers and local irrigation experts who had managed and maintained the earlier hydraulic system had much of their knowledge taken from them.
zh: 不过，或许有人会说，科学终究逐一解决了所遇到的问题。确实，许多问题得到了克服；但这样一来，就必须承认，科学并不是作为一种预先形成的智识来指导工程师的工作。是工程本身形成了科学。
解决办法是在现场摸索出来的。工程学是一种在这些及类似事业中逐渐成形的专门知识。英国工程师在阿斯旺每个施工季结束后回到伦敦，在土木工程师学会会议上宣读论文。这些论文刊登在学会的《会报》上，或发表在《工程师》等专业期刊中。在工地上，工程师可以查阅R. B. 巴克利的《灌溉袖珍手册》；其中列出的砂浆接缝黏结力、不同材料因吸湿而膨胀的数值，均基于早先工程的观察。
这种专门知识是混合的，不是一种从外部应用于世界的智识，而是另一种人为制成的构成体。如果再加上威尔科克斯的观点——旧有盆地灌溉系统比取代它的拦河坝与水库更为精密——那么结论就是：在某些方面，工程建设并非把知识应用于世界，而是把知识从世界中取走。英国工程师从大坝那里学到了一些东西，并把这些知识带进科学期刊和灌溉手册；但曾管理和维护旧有水利系统的农民与当地灌溉专家，却被剥夺了他们的大量知识。

en: The questions and disputes posed by the building of the dam were not restricted to debates within professional journals and discussions among engineers at the site. The problems spilled over and drew in government officials and employees, archaeologists, the national and European press, entrepreneurs and investors, and an increasing number of Egyptian intellectuals and political figures. The reservoir behind the dam inundated the great Temple of Philae and other ancient sites. Archaeologists campaigned against the building of the dam in the European press and at scientific congresses.

Cost overruns led to conflicts among financiers, government engineers, contractors, and outsiders, which continued for years and were taken up in national politics. In 1919 Willcocks criticized the postwar plans of the Ministry of Public Works to build two further dams in Sudan, claiming the plans were based on faulty calculations of the Nile flow and pointing out that one of the dams, at Jabal Aulia, would submerge valuable agricultural land and displace and cause suffering to a large population.

Science was formed in these wars, and so was the country’s new national politics. Willcocks’s proposal to increase the height of the Aswan Dam a second time as an alternative to controlling the Nile from Sudan was taken up by the nationalist movement during the 1919 uprising against the British. Willcocks found himself put on trial for sedition and criminal libel.
The disputes continued, especially after commissions of inquiry discovered that the ministry’s program included further, more serious miscalculations.
zh: 筑坝引发的问题与争论，并不限于专业期刊上的辩论和工地工程师之间的讨论。问题向外扩散，卷入了政府官员与雇员、考古学家、埃及与欧洲的报界、企业家与投资者，以及越来越多的埃及知识分子和政治人物。坝后水库淹没了宏伟的菲莱神庙和其他古迹。考古学家在欧洲报刊和科学大会上发动反对筑坝的运动。
成本超支引起金融家、政府工程师、承包商和外部人士之间的冲突，持续多年，并进入了国家政治。1919年，威尔科克斯批评公共工程部战后在苏丹再建两座大坝的计划，认为其依据的是对尼罗河流量的错误计算，并指出其中位于杰贝勒奥利亚的一座大坝将淹没宝贵农田，使大批人口流离失所、蒙受苦难。
科学在这些争斗中形成，这个国家新兴的民族政治也是如此。威尔科克斯提出再次加高阿斯旺大坝，以替代从苏丹控制尼罗河的方案；这一建议在1919年的反英起义中被民族主义运动采纳。威尔科克斯却发现自己因煽动叛乱和刑事诽谤而遭到审判。
争论仍在继续，尤其是调查委员会发现该部计划中还有更多、更严重的计算错误之后。

en: The aim of those involved in the disputes, one might say, was to “personify” the forces of nature in politics, that is, to translate their potential into human projects. As with ʿAbbud’s later attempt to personify certain circulations of capital, chemical fertilizer, and electricity, the forces put to work, although portrayed as nature or material resources and therefore subject to human expertise and planning, never quite accepted this secondary role. There were always certain effects that went beyond the calculations, certain forces that exceeded human intention. Scientific expertise and national politics were produced out of this tension.
zh: 可以说，卷入争论的各方，旨在使自然力量在政治中“人格化”，也就是把它们的潜能转化为人的计划。正如阿布德后来试图使资本、化肥和电力的某些流转人格化一样，那些被投入运作的力量，虽被描绘成自然或物质资源，因而应当服从人的专门知识与规划，却从未完全接受这种次要角色。总有某些效果超出计算，总有某些力量超出人的意图。科学专门知识与民族政治，正是从这种张力中产生的。

en: The gambiae mosquito, as we know, figured nowhere in these rival plans and calculations for the dam, or in the technical and political battles that followed. When it took advantage of the new reservoirs and river movements and arrived unexpectedly in Aswan, however, a similar struggle developed to draw the insect into a variety of political alliances. In interwar Cairo the political problems of the countryside, associated with the spread of perennial irrigation, the development of commercial agriculture, the growth of large estates, and increasing poverty, indebtedness, landlessness, hunger, and parasitic infection among the fellahs, or peasants, were translated by those in power into problems of what was called “public health.” They were to be solved by government programs of rural social improvement and hygiene. The Wafd government of 1936 created a Ministry of Health, and when the party returned to power with British help in 1942, one of its first acts was to pass the Law for the Improvement of Village Health.“The growth of the democratic and national spirit in Egypt after the war,” wrote an Egyptian political economist in 1940, referring to the period since World War I,“has made the nation aware that helping the fellah is not only a duty but also an insurance against social unrest. . . . The creation of a Ministry of Health in 1936 and of an independent Section of the Ministry of the Interior devoted to the planning and execution of rural reforms, is a welcome sign of increased public interest in the fellah.”

The arrival of gambiae malaria was interpreted by those in power as evidence confirming the need for this program of social and hydraulic engineering. The problems of Egypt were those of limited natural resources and a deficient public health, and were to be overcome by the methods of techno-science. In December 1942 the new minister of health, ʿAbd al-Wahid al-Wakil, blamed the malaria epidemic on the failure of previous governments to carry through with the hydroelectric scheme promoted by his friend ʿAbbud and with further irrigation projects, arguing that these would have raised the standard of living in the south and made its population healthy enough to resist the epidemic.
zh: 我们已经知道，在这些相互竞争的大坝计划与计算中，或在随后的技术与政治争斗中，冈比亚按蚊始终没有位置。然而，当它利用新水库和河水的流动，出人意料地抵达阿斯旺时，一场类似的斗争随即展开：各方试图把这种昆虫拉入不同的政治联盟。在两次世界大战之间的开罗，乡村的政治问题——与常年灌溉扩展、商品农业发展、大地产增长，以及法拉赫即农民日益严重的贫困、负债、失地、饥饿与寄生虫感染相联系的问题——被掌权者转译成所谓的“公共卫生”问题。它们将由政府的乡村社会改良与卫生计划加以解决。1936年的华夫脱党政府设立了卫生部；1942年，该党在英国帮助下重新执政后，最初采取的行动之一就是通过《改善村庄卫生法》。一位埃及政治经济学家1940年写道，所指的是第一次世界大战以来的时期：“战后埃及民主与民族精神的增长，使国民认识到，帮助农民不仅是一项义务，也是防范社会动荡的一种保障……1936年卫生部的设立，以及内政部专设一个负责规划和实施乡村改革的独立部门，是公众日益关心农民的可喜迹象。”
掌权者把冈比亚按蚊疟疾的到来，解读为进一步证实这项社会与水利工程计划之必要性的证据。埃及的问题是自然资源有限、公共卫生不足，应由技术科学的方法加以克服。1942年12月，新任卫生部长阿卜杜勒·瓦希德·瓦基勒把疟疾流行归咎于历届政府未能推行其朋友阿布德所倡导的水电计划及进一步的灌溉工程；他声称，这些工程本可提高南方的生活水平，使当地人口足够健康，能够抵御疫情。

en: Before the war, the program of public health and public works allowed no place for more radical discussions of the question of private property in the countryside. Warning that the rural population, in the language of public health, was “dead as regards healthy nationalistic life,” a number of political figures had called for limited measures to alleviate the increasing hardship caused by commercial agriculture and large-scale landownership, and even the government tried to introduce agricultural rent controls. But the issue of property rights was not raised.

It was symptomatic of prevailing attitudes toward entitlement that when the wartime fertilizer crisis led to food rationing, supplies were assigned to different groups according to income, with higher income groups getting bigger rations.
zh: 战前，公共卫生与公共工程计划没有给更激进地讨论乡村私有财产问题留下空间。一些政治人物借用公共卫生的语言，警告说乡村人口“就健全的民族主义生活而言，已经死去”，呼吁采取有限措施，缓解商品农业与大规模土地所有制造成的日益严重的困苦；连政府也曾试图实行农业地租管制。但财产权问题并未被提起。
战时肥料危机引发粮食配给后，各群体按收入获得供应，收入较高者获得的配给更多；这正体现了当时对谁有权得到什么的主流态度。

en: But the impact of the mosquito’s arrival was not so easily controlled. If ʿAbbud’s associates translated the malaria epidemic into renewed arguments for projects of public health and public works, the mosquito could be taken up by rival groups in other directions. A group of women from wealthy families closely associated with the Egyptian royal family, which opposed the Wafd government and the British, organized soup kitchens and other relief projects in the south to aid the malaria victims. By drawing attention to the crisis they provided the royal palace with an opportunity to embarrass the government.

But they in turn could be embarrassed by the mosquito. The wealthy women invited a young journalist to visit and describe their relief efforts. The journalist, later to become a leading writer, reported instead that the women themselves were like mosquitoes. They belonged to the class of Egyptians who “suck the people’s blood and turn it into cakes, caviar and champagne.” The rich were the real epidemic, he wrote, and their opulent palaces were no better than the stagnant pools in which the mosquitoes bred.
zh: 但蚊子到来的影响并不那么容易控制。如果阿布德的伙伴把疟疾流行转译成再次支持公共卫生与公共工程项目的论据，竞争集团也可以把蚊子引向其他方向。一群出身富裕家庭的妇女，在南方组织施粥站及其他救济项目，援助疟疾受害者；她们与反对华夫脱党政府和英国的埃及王室关系密切。通过使危机受到关注，她们为王宫提供了令政府难堪的机会。
但蚊子也可能反过来令她们难堪。这些富裕妇女邀请一位年轻记者前来参观并报道她们的救济工作。那位后来成为著名作家的记者，却写道，这些妇女自己就像蚊子。她们属于那个“吸人民的血，把它变成蛋糕、鱼子酱和香槟”的埃及阶级。他写道，富人才是真正的瘟疫，她们奢华的宫邸并不比蚊子孳生的死水塘更好。

en: The mosquito was put to work by critics of the ruling order to alter the terms of national debate. As the malaria epidemic in the south became public knowledge in Cairo, a number of individual reformers turned the crisis into an argument for more radical change. Rejecting the government view that the high death toll reflected poor sanitary conditions in the countryside and the need for further public works, they linked the crisis to the unequal distribution of land. One deputy in parliament claimed that the standard of living in the Soviet Union, where land was held in common, was much higher, and others drew attention to the successful land reform programs of Eastern Europe. From 1944 to 1947 and again in 1951, bills were introduced into parliament modeled on these reforms, proposing to bar owners of more than fifty acres from acquiring additional land.
The measures were blocked in parliament and no party made land reform an issue.

Instead, in March 1948 the government launched a program to distribute land reclaimed from the desert in five-acre plots to small farmers, who also received “hygienic houses” grouped in four villages, each equipped with a school, mosque, health unit, and public bath.

With such measures, made possible by the raising of the dam at Aswan, there seemed no immediate threat to the power of men like Ahmad ʿAbbud, who were able to consolidate their political and economic position. Yet thanks to the malaria epidemic and to the food shortages and poverty it had made visible, the question of land reform was now in circulation.
zh: 统治秩序的批评者利用蚊子，改变了全国讨论的议题与方式。当南方的疟疾疫情在开罗成为公开的知识时，一些改革者把危机转化为主张更激进变革的论据。他们拒绝政府的解释——高死亡率反映了乡村卫生条件恶劣，以及进一步兴办公共工程的必要——转而把危机同土地分配不均联系起来。一位议员声称，在土地公有的苏联，生活水平高得多；另一些人则提请注意东欧成功的土地改革计划。1944至1947年，以及1951年，仿照这些改革的法案被提交议会，提议禁止拥有五十费丹以上土地者继续购入土地。
这些措施在议会遭到阻挠，没有一个政党把土地改革作为政治议题。
政府转而在1948年3月启动了一项计划：把从沙漠开垦出的土地以五费丹为一块分给小农；他们还获得了“卫生住房”，集中在四个村庄中，每村都配有学校、清真寺、卫生站和公共浴室。
借助这些因阿斯旺大坝加高而成为可能的措施，艾哈迈德·阿布德这样的人似乎没有面临直接的权力威胁，反而能够巩固自己的政治经济地位。然而，得益于疟疾疫情，以及它使之显露的粮食短缺与贫困，土地改革的问题如今已开始流传。

en: ʿAbbud’s electricity and fertilizer schemes were interrupted in October 1944, when his political rivals managed to bring down the Wafd government. Five years later, however, he formed an alliance with the rival Misr group, and together in 1950 they helped put the Wafd back in power and secure their monopolistic economic positions. ʿAbbud’s empire expanded with acquisitions in tourism and textile manufacturing, and new ventures to manufacture paper and perfumes, both using byproducts of the sugar industry.

He abandoned the proposal to build a nitrate plant at Aswan powered by hydroelectricity, which was to become a government project. In its place he took advantage of capital loans and a new nitrogen-fixing technology available from the United States to build a fertilizer factory at Suez, powered not with Nile waters but waste gases from the nearby Shell oil field.
zh: 1944年10月，阿布德的政敌成功推翻华夫脱党政府，他的电力与肥料计划随之中断。然而，五年后，他同竞争对手米斯尔集团结盟；1950年，双方共同帮助华夫脱党重新执政，并保障了自身的经济垄断地位。阿布德的帝国通过收购旅游业和纺织制造业的企业而扩张，又创办了造纸和香水企业，两者都利用制糖业的副产品。
他放弃了在阿斯旺兴建水电驱动硝酸盐工厂的提议，该计划随后将成为政府项目。他转而利用来自美国的资本贷款和新型固氮技术，在苏伊士建立了一座肥料厂；其动力不再来自尼罗河水，而来自附近壳牌油田的废气。

en: The fertilizer factory was funded by the United States as an emblem of its postwar role in the country, “the most substantial, tangible example of American economic assistance to Egypt,” as the U.S. Embassy reminded Washington.

The Americans planned to build political influence and at the same time subsidize their own industrial technology through a program of “technical assistance,” which would organize postwar international relations around a politics of techno-economic development. Besides the fertilizer factory, in its first years the assistance program also funded a pilot scheme for the introduction of hybrid corn, the supply of six helicopters from United Helicopters of Palo Alto, California, for spraying crops with new chemical pesticides (more on that in a moment), a demonstration project for well drainage to restore land that, thanks to the dam, was “deteriorating from excess irrigation and salinity,” and a new technology for building houses of mud brick.

People in the Nile valley had been building their houses with mud brick for several millennia, of course, so this last item needs explanation. Arthur D. Little, the Boston-based consulting firm advising the U.S. mission, had determined that an improvement to mud bricks was “an essential part” of Egypt’s techno-economic development. The peasant’s house “is never clean,” the embassy reported to Washington. “The very nature of the mud brick promotes dust rather than cleanliness. Its surface is porous and will not readily take whitewash or paint.”

The consultants received a contract to build twenty mud brick houses by a new process, using “a special mud brick making machine” instead of the traditional wooden mold, and improving the normal mixture of mud and straw by the addition of oil. From the twenty demonstration houses, it was hoped, “the knowledge of how to build such a house will be spread throughout Egypt.”
zh: 这座肥料厂由美国出资，象征着美国战后在埃及的角色。正如美国使馆提醒华盛顿的那样，它是“美国对埃及经济援助最实质、最有形的例子”。
美国人计划通过“技术援助”建立政治影响，同时补贴本国工业技术；这一计划将围绕技术—经济发展的政治，组织战后国际关系。除了肥料厂，援助计划在最初几年还资助了引入杂交玉米的试点；从加利福尼亚州帕洛阿尔托的联合直升机公司供应六架直升机，用于向农作物喷洒新型化学杀虫剂——稍后还会谈到；开展井式排水示范项目，修复那些拜大坝所赐、正“因过度灌溉与盐分而退化”的土地；以及一项用泥砖建房的新技术。
当然，尼罗河谷居民已经用泥砖建房数千年了，因此最后这一项需要解释。为美国援助团提供咨询的波士顿公司亚瑟·D. 利特尔认定，改良泥砖是埃及技术—经济发展“必不可少的一部分”。使馆向华盛顿报告，农民的房子“从来不干净”。“泥砖的性质本身就助长灰尘，而不是洁净。它的表面多孔，不容易刷上石灰浆或涂料。”
顾问们获得合同，要用新工艺建造二十座泥砖房，以“一种专门的制泥砖机器”取代传统木模，并在通常的泥土与秸秆混合物中加入油，以改良砖料。人们希望通过这二十座示范房，“建造这种房屋的知识将传遍埃及”。

en: There were three significant features of this new politics based on technical expertise. First, as with the dam at Aswan, it represented a concentration and reorganization of knowledge rather than an introduction of expertise where none had been in use before. Technical knowledge was to be focused into pilot projects and demonstration sites, from where it would spread throughout the land. Villages in Egypt already had a straightforward method of plastering over mud brick, using particular local clays mixed with straw, employed whenever a house needed smoother or more impressive walls. But existing practice, like the old knowledge of irrigation, involved an expertise that was too widely dispersed to provide a means for building imperial power—or the profits of a Boston consulting firm.
zh: 这种以技术专长为基础的新政治，有三个重要特征。首先，同阿斯旺大坝一样，它体现的是知识的集中与重组，而不是把专门知识带入此前从未运用过它的地方。技术知识将集中于试点项目和示范地点，再从那里传播到全国。埃及村庄本来就有一种直接有效的泥砖抹灰方法：将某些当地黏土与秸秆混合，在房屋需要更光滑或更气派的墙面时使用。但既有实践同旧有灌溉知识一样，所包含的专门知识分布得过于广泛，无法成为建立帝国权力——或为一家波士顿咨询公司赚取利润——的手段。

en: Second, as with the engineering at Aswan, the projects encountered continuous practical difficulties. In fact, every one of them failed. The seedlings of hybrid corn “withered,” the oil-stabilized mud brick was a failure, the use of helicopters had “run into various complications” (they broke down), and the new nitrogen-fixing technology for the manufacture of fertilizer did not work as planned. “It will be a long time before the fertilizer plant will produce satisfactorily,” the embassy reported to Washington in November 1951. “The basic process is faulty from the design standpoint. Some of the engineering was done in New York and parts in London and it turns out to have been a weak job.”

As at Aswan, the technical experts tried to learn from these failures. Repairs were improvised, opportunistic alternatives were introduced, and goals were reformulated. But what this means is that technical expertise did not work by bringing science and technology to develop natural resources. It happened just as much the other way around, and in ways that tended to be incomplete or unrealizable. So-called nature formed the expertise, which never completely escaped its compromising origins.
zh: 其次，与阿斯旺工程一样，这些项目不断遇到实际困难。事实上，每一个都失败了。杂交玉米幼苗“枯萎”了，加油稳定的泥砖失败了，直升机的使用“遇到了各种复杂情况”——也就是机器坏了——而用于制造肥料的新型固氮技术，也没有按计划运转。1951年11月，使馆向华盛顿报告：“肥料厂要达到令人满意的生产状态，还需要很长时间。”“基本工艺从设计角度看就有缺陷。一部分工程在纽约完成，另一部分在伦敦完成，结果证明做得很差。”
如同在阿斯旺一样，技术专家试图从这些失败中学习。他们临时修补，因势引入替代方案，重新制定目标。但这意味着，技术专长的运作，并不是把科学与技术带来开发自然资源。事情同样会反过来发生，而且往往以不完整或无法实现的方式发生。所谓的自然塑造了专门知识，而后者从未完全摆脱其令人尴尬的起源。

en: Third, however, it was an important aspect of the politics of technical expertise that these failures and adjustments were overlooked, in fact actively covered up. Techno-science had to conceal its extrascientific origins. Nowhere, first of all, was it mentioned that every one of these technologies—crop spraying, high-yield corn, drainage mechanisms, fertilizer plants, or a mud brick more resistant to disease—were themselves responses (and unsuccessful responses) to problems caused by earlier techno-scientific projects, in particular the Aswan Dam. Beyond this, the fundamental difficulties were presented as minor issues of the improper implementation of the plans, unexpected complications, bureaucratic delays, or the need to follow up. The hybrid corn, it was decided, needed to be recultivated with greater quantities of pesticide. The helicopters needed a larger and more continuous supply of spare parts from California. The new mud brick technology had to overcome political objections from the Ministry of Social Affairs, which believed that modern housing should be built of concrete. The pattern was set from the very start with ʿAbbud’s nitrate factory at Suez. Since the factory was built to manufacture not just fertilizer but the political effectiveness of an imperial power, the mistakes in design and engineering could not be made public. No one was to be told that the engineering was a weak job, or that the entire plant was wrong, as the jargon put it,“from the design standpoint.”The embassy promised ʿAbbud and his U.S. partners that “we would cooperate fully in keeping the situation quiet. In response to inquiries we would continue to say that operating difficulties in the early phases are to be expected from any new chemical process factory.”
zh: 然而，第三点是，忽略这些失败与调整——实际上是主动加以掩盖——构成了技术专长政治的一个重要方面。技术科学必须遮蔽其科学之外的起源。首先，没有任何地方提到，这些技术中的每一种——作物喷药、高产玉米、排水机制、肥料厂，或更有利于防病的泥砖——本身都是对早先技术科学项目、尤其是阿斯旺大坝所造成问题的回应，而且是不成功的回应。不仅如此，根本性的困难被说成是些小问题：计划执行不当、意外的复杂情况、官僚拖延，或需要后续跟进。人们决定，杂交玉米需要用更多杀虫剂重新培育；直升机需要从加利福尼亚获得数量更大、供应更持续的备件；新型泥砖技术需要克服社会事务部的政治反对，该部认为现代住房应由混凝土建造。这种模式从阿布德在苏伊士的硝酸盐工厂一开始就已确立。既然工厂不仅要制造肥料，也要制造帝国权力的政治效力，那么设计和工程错误就不能公之于众。不能让任何人知道工程做得差，也不能让人知道整座工厂用行话说“从设计角度看”就是错的。使馆向阿布德及其美国伙伴保证：“我们将全力配合，使此事不声张。有人询问时，我们将继续表示，任何采用新化学工艺的工厂，在运行初期出现困难都是可以预料的。”

en: Techno-politics is always a technical body, an alloy that must emerge from a process of manufacture whose ingredients are both human and nonhuman, both intentional and not, and in which the intentional or the human is always somewhat overrun by the unintended. But it is a particular form of manufacturing, a certain way of organizing the amalgam of human and nonhuman, things and ideas, so that the human, the intellectual, the realm of intentions and ideas seems to come first and to control and organize the nonhuman.
zh: 技术政治始终是一种技术性构成体，一种必须从制造过程中生成的合金；其成分既有人也有非人，既有意图也有非意图，而有意图的或人的部分，总会在某种程度上被非预期之物冲破。但它是一种特殊的制造形式，是以某种方式组织人和非人、事物与观念的混合物，使人的、智识的、意图和观念的领域看起来先行存在，并控制和组织非人之物。

en: ʿAbbud’s new fortunes were short-lived. Postwar protests against conditions in the countryside intensified, and a popular campaign against the British role in Egypt culminated in the Cairo fire of January 26, 1952, when Shepeard’s Hotel, symbol of the British presence, was burned down. A newly appointed government began to move against ʿAbbud’s business monopoly. After failing to get him to pay E£5 million in tax arrears, the Ministry of Finance decided to nationalize his sugar company. ʿAbbud in response was reported to have bribed the king, who dismissed the government after four months in office.

As the political crisis developed, on July 23, 1952, junior officers in the Egyptian army led by Jamal Abdul Nasser carried out a coup d’état. Within six weeks they passed a land reform law and announced that postwar proposals to build a second and far larger dam at Aswan would go ahead, as the centerpiece of postindependence state building.
zh: 阿布德的新一轮好运并不长久。战后，抗议乡村状况的活动不断加剧，反对英国在埃及所扮演角色的民众运动，在1952年1月26日的开罗大火中达到高潮：象征英国存在的谢泼德饭店被烧毁。一个新任政府开始打击阿布德的商业垄断。财政部未能让他缴清五百万埃及镑的欠税，遂决定将其糖业公司国有化。据报道，阿布德以贿赂国王作为回应，国王在政府执政四个月后将其解散。
政治危机不断发展，1952年7月23日，由贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔领导的埃及陆军中下级军官发动政变。六周之内，他们通过了土地改革法，并宣布将推进战后提出的方案，在阿斯旺兴建第二座、规模大得多的大坝，作为独立后国家建设的核心。

en: These actions, followed by the 1956 nationalization of the Suez Canal and the Suez crisis, brought on by the abrupt U.S. withdrawal of support for the Aswan High Dam, are now remembered as a turning point in Egypt’s politics. But Nasser and his fellow officers had not seized power with the aim of carrying out land reform or building a postcolonial state around the Aswan project. Concerned principally with the incompetence and corruption of the army high command, they took control when they suddenly feared their own arrest.

They forced the king to abdicate in favor of his infant son and appointed a reformist prime minister with the aim of restoring a less corrupt and oligarchic parliamentary order. Since proposals for land reform were circulating, however, and were even advocated by the U.S. Embassy (as a defense against an imagined communist threat), they offered the means for an insecure new regime to win popular approval and weaken the few dozen oligarchs like ʿAbbud obstructing political reform. The army regime went on to expropriate all the estates of the royal family, but for others set the maximum holding relatively high, at three hundred acres.

The high limit and the ease with which it was evaded ensured that relatively little land was redistributed, but the reform did establish rent controls and tenant rights that improved conditions in every village, until their abrogation in October 1997. ʿAbbud lost most of his six-thousand-acre sugar plantation, and subsequently, as the military government moved against “the monopolies” and other rival sources of power, his business empire as well.
Hydropolitics had made ʿAbbud rich, but had also set in motion other forces, not least the mosquito, that combined to bring him down.
zh: 这些行动，以及随后的1956年苏伊士运河国有化和苏伊士危机——后两者由美国突然撤回对阿斯旺高坝的支持所触发——如今被铭记为埃及政治的转折点。但纳赛尔及其同僚夺取权力时，目标并不是实行土地改革，或围绕阿斯旺工程建设后殖民国家。他们主要关心军队高级指挥层的无能与腐败，在突然担忧自己将被捕时才夺取了控制权。
他们迫使国王退位、让位给尚在襁褓中的儿子，并任命一位改革派首相，意在恢复一个较少腐败、较少寡头色彩的议会秩序。不过，土地改革提案已经在流传，甚至得到美国使馆的倡导，被当作防范想象中的共产主义威胁的办法；因此，它们为立足未稳的新政权提供了赢得民众赞同、削弱阿布德等几十名阻挠政治改革的寡头的手段。军人政权随后没收了王室的全部地产，但对其他人设定的土地持有上限相对较高，为三百费丹。
较高的上限，加上规避起来十分容易，使得实际重新分配的土地相对很少；但改革确立了地租管制和佃农权利，改善了每个村庄的状况，直至这些措施于1997年10月被废除。阿布德失去了六千费丹甘蔗种植园中的大部分土地；后来，随着军政府打击“垄断集团”和其他竞争性权力来源，他又失去了商业帝国。
水政治使阿布德致富，却也启动了其他力量，尤其是蚊子；这些力量合在一起，促成了他的垮台。

en: Similar combinations formed the genealogy of the High Dam, involving exchanges among hydropower, fertilizers, economic collapse, and war. During World War I American fear of Germany’s new nitrate technology, and its own dependence on the single natural source of nitrates in Chile, persuaded Congress to include in the National Defense Act of 1916 the funds to build a mammoth nitrogen-fixing plant at Muscle Shoals in northern Alabama. The project included the construction of a large dam nearby, with a hydroelectric power station to supply the great quantities of electricity consumed in nitrogen fixing. At the war’s end, after a $100 million federal investment, both the factory and the partially completed dam and power station were uneconomic and useless.

This technical failure, however, enabled something much larger to result. In July 1921, Henry Ford proposed a scheme not just for this corner of northern Alabama, but for the entire river basin to which it belonged, linking together industry, hydroelectric power, transmission grids, river navigation, soil improvement through artificial fertilizer, and scientific agriculture. The proposal envisioned an expansion of the industrial coordination schemes that Ford had pioneered, from the scale of car factories and suburban lifestyles, to the transformation of the entire ecology of a geographic region, organized around the technicized space of the damming of a river system and the transforming of its energy into unlimited hydropower. The scale of federal support that Ford demanded for the project ensured the opposition of his business rivals, and the proposal was rejected. But with the economic collapse of the Great Depression the project was revived by the federal government. In 1933 an act of congress put Ford’s scheme into effect as the country’s largest public works project, the Tennessee Valley Authority.
zh: 类似的组合构成了高坝的谱系，其中涉及水电、肥料、经济崩溃与战争之间的交换。第一次世界大战期间，美国既畏惧德国的新型硝酸盐技术，又依赖智利这个唯一的天然硝酸盐来源，因此国会被说服，在1916年《国防法》中列入资金，在阿拉巴马州北部马斯尔肖尔斯兴建一座巨型固氮厂。项目还包括在附近修建一座大坝，并配设水电站，供应固氮所消耗的大量电力。战争结束时，联邦已经投入一亿美元，而工厂及尚未完工的大坝和电站却既不经济，也无用处。

然而，这次技术失败使一个更大的结果成为可能。1921年7月，亨利·福特提出一个方案，不仅针对阿拉巴马州北部这一角，而是面向它所属的整个流域，把工业、水电、输电网、河运、利用人工肥料改良土壤，以及科学农业联系在一起。该提案设想把福特首创的工业协调方案，从汽车工厂和郊区生活方式的尺度，扩展到整个地理区域生态的转变；这一转变围绕技术化的空间展开，即给一套河流系统筑坝，并把它的能量转化为无限的水电。福特要求联邦提供巨额支持，必然招致其商业对手反对，提案因此遭到否决。但随着大萧条带来的经济崩溃，联邦政府重新启动了这个项目。1933年，国会通过法案，把福特的方案付诸实施，成为全国最大的公共工程项目——田纳西河流域管理局。

en: The TVA, the child of earlier technical and political failures, came to epitomize the new possibilities of development and planning, especially in arid regions such as the Middle East. Large dams offered a way to build not just irrigation and power systems, but nation-states themselves. In 1949 the United Nations sent an economic survey mission to the Middle East. Its head was Gordon Clapp, the chairman of the TVA board. The following year, two World Bank experts writing on development in the Middle East explained how since 1930, “the popular imagination has been captured by the idea of the development of entire river systems.”

In the following years the old schemes of ʿAbbud and his rivals for a hydroelectric plant and fertilizer factory at Aswan were taken up by the new military government in Egypt. But they now formed part of a TVA-inspired scheme to build the second dam, on a mammoth scale, just above the existing dam at Aswan. Work began in 1964 and was completed in 1971. Ignoring the costs of salinization, waterlogging, declining soil fertility, the displacement of the people of Nubia, the loss of an archaeological heritage, increased disease, coastal erosion, the destruction of a large fishing industry, the loss of water due to evaporation and seepage, and other problems already evident from the first dam, and without even attempting studies of costs and benefits, the Aswan High Dam became the centerpiece of postwar nation making in Egypt.
zh: 田纳西河流域管理局是早先技术与政治失败的产物，却成为发展与规划新可能性的典范，在中东等干旱地区尤其如此。大型水坝提供了一种途径，不仅建设灌溉和电力系统，也建设民族国家本身。1949年，联合国向中东派出经济调查团，团长是田纳西河流域管理局董事会主席戈登·克拉普。次年，两位世界银行专家在论述中东发展时说明，自1930年以来，“开发整个河流系统的想法已经俘获了公众的想象力”。

随后几年，阿布德及其对手早年在阿斯旺兴建水电站和肥料厂的方案，被埃及新的军政府接纳。但它们如今成为受田纳西河流域管理局启发的一项计划的组成部分：在阿斯旺现有大坝稍上游，兴建规模庞大的第二座坝。工程于1964年开始，1971年完成。阿斯旺高坝忽略了盐碱化、渍涝、土壤肥力下降、努比亚人口被迁移、考古遗产丧失、疾病增加、海岸侵蚀、大型渔业遭到破坏，以及蒸发和渗漏造成的水量损失等代价，也忽略了第一座大坝已显现的其他问题，甚至没有尝试开展成本与收益研究，却成为战后埃及民族国家建构的核心。
body.review: 底本写1964年开工、1971年完成，照录。埃及水资源与灌溉部的工程年表列1960年1月9日为第一阶段开工、1964年5月为截流、1970年7月为主体完成、1971年1月15日为正式落成典礼；须区别这些节点。

en: Marx published some famous lines about an insect—not the mosquito, but the bee. Although it builds itself an elaborate hive, he wrote, the bee is no architect, for the architect “raises his structure in imagination before he erects it in reality.”

Since Marx wrote those words we have come to believe more and more that this Cartesian notion of the mind-as-architect’s-office is what captures the difference between ourselves and nature. The work of imagination puts together plans, images, ideal structures—in fact entire systems of culture and meaning—before they are taken outside and erected in reality. We have made do for too long with this misleadingly simple view of the world that Marx himself placed in question. I have already suggested by describing the work of the engineers at Aswan why this is misleading, and have offered other examples elsewhere.

I could make the point again simply by recalling the work an architect actually does: the visits to the site and consultations with the client that precede any attempt at drawing; the long, eye-straining hours with the CAD program; the printing and distribution of drawings; the meetings around a table with the plans spread out to negotiate the rules of building codes and planning regulations; the day-to-day supervision of the building contractor; the arbitrating among electrical, plumbing, and ventilation contractors installing rival networks of cables, pipes, and ducts; the measurements that do not fit; the overlooked details; and the changes of mind as things are taken apart and redone. There is no disputing that all this involves a constant work of imagination, but none of it precedes or stands apart from doing things in reality. There is no other, more real world. Nowhere does one suddenly step from imagination to reality, from plan to real thing, any more than did the engineers at Aswan.
zh: 马克思写过几句关于昆虫的名言——不是蚊子，而是蜜蜂。他写道，尽管蜜蜂能为自己建造精巧的蜂巢，它却不是建筑师，因为建筑师“在现实中建起结构之前，已先在想象中把它建起来”。
自马克思写下这些话以来，我们愈发相信，这种把心灵当作建筑师事务所的笛卡尔式观念，抓住了我们与自然之间的差别。想象工作先组织起计划、图像、理想结构——实际上是整套文化与意义系统——然后再把它们带到外面，在现实中建造出来。我们依赖这种简单得具有误导性的世界观已经太久了，而马克思本人也曾对它提出质疑。我已通过描述阿斯旺工程师的工作，说明它何以具有误导性，并在别处给出过其他例子。

只要回想一下建筑师实际所做的工作，我就能再次说明这一点：动笔绘图前的现场考察和客户商谈；长时间盯着计算机辅助设计程序、令人眼睛疲劳的工作；图纸的印制与分发；围坐桌旁、摊开图纸，就建筑规范与规划条例进行协商的会议；对建筑承包商的日常监督；在电气、给排水与通风承包商之间进行调解，因为他们安装的电缆、管线与风道网络彼此争夺空间；对不上的尺寸；被忽视的细节；以及拆掉重做时的改变主意。无可争辩，这一切都包含持续的想象工作，但没有哪一项先于现实中的做事，或独立于现实中的做事。不存在另一个更真实的世界。没有哪一个时刻，人会突然从想象迈入现实，从计划走向实物；阿斯旺的工程师如此，建筑师也一样。

en: Yet if we return to the case of the anti-malaria campaign in Egypt, it might be said, surely the difference between the mosquito and the human expert is clear.

may have been clever to make its way across the African continent, but it was no match in the end for the powers of chemical science, human ingenuity, and planning. Perhaps not. Yet here, too, the story of expertise versus nature is too simple. After all, the eradication teams did not kill the mosquitoes barehanded. They needed a lot of nonhuman assistants. Since the end of World War I, the J. R. Geigy company in Switzerland, a manufacturer of dyestuffs for the textile industry (and member of the I. G. Farben chemicals cartel), had been trying to find a safe, effective, and long-lasting substance to use as a mothproofing agent for textiles.

In 1941, with Rommel advancing in North Africa and the gambiae mosquito making its way northwards from Sudan, a company chemist named Paul Müller discovered the toxicity of dichloro-diphenyl-trichloroethane. Mixed 5 percent in an inert powder, the chemical was found to kill clothes moths and many other insects yet seemed to have no effect on warm-blooded animals. Since it was a contact rather than an oral poison, it proved to be a potent killer even of bloodsucking insects, which do not ingest poisons, including human lice, the parasite responsible for transmitting typhus.

The disease that brought Fred Soper of the Rockefeller Foundation to Cairo the following year, typhus was a major threat to soldiers at war and civilians in war-torn cities. The British Ministry of Supply named the new Swiss chemical after its initials and began manufacturing DDT in April 1943, giving its production the highest wartime priority alongside radar and penicillin.

The following year, Soper persuaded the Egyptian government to replace pyrethrum—the powder of chrysanthemum flowers—with DDT in the gambiae eradication campaign in southern Egypt. Houses were treated with the chemical, and the ceilings of trains were spray-painted with a mixture of DDT and kerosene, an innovation later copied around the world.
zh: 不过，如果回到埃及的抗疟运动，或许有人会说，蚊子与人类专家之间的差别显然很清楚。冈比亚按蚊能够穿越非洲大陆，或许颇为聪明，但最终仍敌不过化学科学、人类才智与规划的力量。也许确实如此。然而，在这里，把故事讲成专门知识对抗自然，仍然过于简单。毕竟，灭蚊队并不是徒手杀死蚊子的。他们需要许多非人助手。第一次世界大战结束后，瑞士的J. R. 嘉基公司一直试图寻找一种安全、有效、持久的物质，用作纺织品防蛀剂。这家公司为纺织业生产染料，也是法本化学卡特尔的成员。
1941年，隆美尔正在北非推进，冈比亚按蚊正从苏丹北上，公司一位名叫保罗·穆勒的化学家发现了二氯二苯三氯乙烷的毒性。人们发现，把这种化学品以5%的比例混入惰性粉末，能够杀死衣蛾及许多其他昆虫，却似乎不影响温血动物。由于它通过接触而非经口摄入发挥毒性，即使对不吞食毒物的吸血昆虫也能有效杀灭，其中包括传播斑疹伤寒的寄生虫——人虱。
正是斑疹伤寒在次年把洛克菲勒基金会的弗雷德·索珀带到了开罗；它对战场上的士兵和饱受战乱城市中的平民构成重大威胁。英国供应部用这种新型瑞士化学品名称的首字母为其命名，于1943年4月开始生产DDT，并将其生产同雷达和青霉素一道，列为战时最高优先事项。
次年，索珀说服埃及政府，在南部根除冈比亚按蚊的运动中，用DDT取代除虫菊——菊花制成的粉末。房屋用这种化学品处理，火车车厢顶棚则喷涂DDT与煤油的混合物；这一创新后来被世界各地仿效。
body.review: 底本将穆勒发现DDT杀虫毒性的年份写为1941，照录。法兰西公学院2022年相关课程资料将这一发现列于1939年；此处年份存在差异，不能与DDT首次合成年份混同。

en: Neither the companies manufacturing DDT nor the eradication teams using it in Egypt had any idea how the chemical worked. They just admired its potency. In fact, no one knew how it worked, not even the man who introduced its powers. When Müller received the Nobel Prize in Medicine or Physiology in 1948, he won the award for having demonstrated that DDT killed arthropods, not for knowing why.

Bringing its powers into action had required several years of methodical work, testing hundreds of synthesized organic substances on flies trapped inside a Peet-Grady chamber. This was an enclosure or room that simulated an insect’s environment, such as a desert, a rainforest, or the kitchen of an apartment. The insects and the chemical agent were introduced into the chamber while an observer watched through one-way glass.

The discovery that DDT killed the flies was made in the Peet-Grady chamber, not in Müller’s head. Techno-science involved not so much planning in advance or raising structures in the imagination; it involved erecting a room inside the research lab, which rearranged so-called nature, much like the dam at Aswan, concentrating its elements in one place, transporting the rainforest onto the premises of a chemical company, and providing a place where it could be continuously observed. The chain of events that took DDT from the Peet-Grady chamber to the field was a process of borrowing, translations, and things invented for one purpose taken over by other forces, all modulated by the politics of U.S.-British rivalry over Egypt, the needs of war, the accidents and ambitions of a Rockefeller career, and the impact of sugarcane production and irrigation works.
zh: 无论制造DDT的公司，还是在埃及使用它的灭蚊队，都不知道这种化学品如何起作用。他们只是赞叹它的威力。事实上，没有人知道它如何起作用，连把它的力量引入应用的人也不知道。1948年，穆勒获得诺贝尔生理学或医学奖，获奖原因是他证明了DDT能够杀死节肢动物，而不是他知道其中的原因。
要让它的力量发挥作用，需要数年有条不紊的工作：在被关在皮特—格雷迪试验室中的苍蝇身上，测试数百种合成有机物。这是一种封闭空间或房间，模拟昆虫的环境，例如沙漠、雨林或公寓厨房。昆虫和化学药剂被放入其中，观察者则透过单向玻璃观看。

DDT能杀死苍蝇这一发现，是在皮特—格雷迪试验室里作出的，而不是在穆勒脑中作出的。技术科学所涉及的，与其说是预先规划，或在想象中搭建结构，不如说是在研究实验室内建起一个房间。这个房间重新安排了所谓的自然，很像阿斯旺大坝：把各种要素集中在一处，把雨林搬进一家化学公司的场所，并提供一个可以持续观察它的地点。从皮特—格雷迪试验室到田野，DDT经历的一连串事件，是借用、转译，以及为一种目的而发明的事物被其他力量接管的过程；这一切又受制于英美争夺埃及的政治、战争需要、洛克菲勒体系中一段职业生涯的偶然与雄心，以及甘蔗生产和灌溉工程的影响。

en: What is more important, as we now know, while the malaria campaign used the new power of DDT, the pesticide had purposes of its own, well beyond the intentions of the research chemists and the eradication teams. In 1944 the U.S. Army Public Health Service and the American Entomological Society had already begun to issue warnings: that DDT would kill beneficial as well as harmful insects, was poisonous to fish, and was potentially harmful to all forms of plant and animal life. The warnings were ignored. After the “success” of the new chemical in Egypt, and a more famous success in eliminating head lice under Soper’s supervision in Naples (in fact both campaigns mostly employed pyrethrum, with DDT used only at the end, after the epidemics had largely passed), Soper agreed with the advocates of DDT that it was “an almost perfect insecticide.”
zh: 更重要的是，如今我们知道，抗疟运动虽然运用了DDT的新力量，但这种杀虫剂也有它自己的目的，远远超出研究化学家和灭蚊队的意图。1944年，美国陆军公共卫生机构和美国昆虫学会已经开始发出警告：DDT不仅杀死有害昆虫，也会杀死益虫；它对鱼类有毒，并可能伤害一切形式的植物和动物生命。警告遭到忽视。在这种新化学品于埃及取得“成功”之后，以及在索珀监督下于那不勒斯消灭头虱、取得一次更著名的成功之后——事实上，两场运动主要使用的都是除虫菊，DDT只是在疫情大体已经过去之后才于末期使用——索珀赞同DDT倡导者的说法，称它是“一种几乎完美的杀虫剂”。

en: DDT was not in fact a more lethal insecticide than pyrethrum or other chemicals it replaced. Like pyrethrum, it did not attack the malaria parasite directly. The plasmodium spores were too small and too numerous to reach with poison. The new chemical simply interrupted their breeding cycle by intervening at its most vulnerable point, when millions of spores were concentrated in the bodies of a relatively small number of much larger hosts, the female mosquitoes. DDT’s greater effectiveness against mosquitoes was due to its very stable chemical structure. It was practically insoluble in water and resisted degradation by sunlight or soils. So it remained in the environment not for days or weeks, but years and decades. (When it does break down, it was later discovered, the resulting products include DDD, which is also toxic and resists decomposition for up to 190 years.) When sprayed in a house DDT lingered, so it “vaccinated” the place long enough to interrupt the mosquito’s breeding cycle, and without the impractical need to seal up the house, as the pyrethrum spray required.
zh: 事实上，DDT的杀虫毒力并不高于除虫菊或它所取代的其他化学品。同除虫菊一样，它不直接攻击疟原虫。疟原虫的孢子太小、太多，毒物难以触及。这种新化学品只是在其繁殖周期最脆弱的一环介入，从而将其打断：在这个环节，数以百万计的孢子集中于数量相对较少、体型大得多的宿主——雌蚊——体内。DDT对蚊子更有效，是由于其化学结构非常稳定。它几乎不溶于水，也能抵抗阳光或土壤中的降解。因此，它在环境中停留的不是几天或几周，而是几年、几十年。后来人们发现，即使它分解了，产物中也包括DDD；后者同样有毒，并可抵抗分解长达190年。DDT喷进房屋后会持续残留，因此它为房屋“接种”的保护期足以打断蚊子的繁殖周期，而且不需要像除虫菊喷雾那样，把房屋封闭起来——那在实践中很难做到。

en: In Egypt, however, DDT (and pyrethrum) also gained their effectiveness from special features of the gambiae mosquito—or rather, of the social relations between the mosquito and its human hosts. As in Brazil, the insect was a new immigrant, so it was not well established in the local community and was comparatively easy to isolate. At the same time, the
is the most social form of malarial mosquito. It is especially dependent on its human hosts, preferring human blood to animal.

Thus it is generally found only around human habitation. This makes it unable to travel long distances, hence the importance of boats, trains, and floating weeds for its travel. But the dependence on humans also made it easier to eradicate, because the spraying of houses and vehicles only was relatively effective. For all these reasons, a methodical and relentless vector eradication campaign, taking on the mosquito pool by pool, house by house, and village by village, was successful.
zh: 然而，在埃及，DDT及除虫菊的效力，也来自冈比亚按蚊的特殊特征——更确切地说，来自蚊子与人类宿主之间社会关系的特殊性。同巴西一样，这种昆虫是新移民，尚未在当地群落中稳固立足，因此相对容易隔离。同时，冈比亚按蚊又是最具社会性的传疟蚊。它尤其依赖人类宿主，比起动物血液更偏好人血。
因此，它通常只出现在人类居住地周围。这使它无法远距离迁移，也就凸显了船、火车和漂浮水草对于它移动的重要性。但对人的依赖也使它更容易被根除，因为只对房屋和车辆喷药就相对有效。由于这些原因，一场有条不紊且毫不松懈的媒介根除运动，逐个水池、逐座房屋、逐个村庄地对付蚊子，取得了成功。

en: As a result, the malaria experts drew the wrong lessons from Egypt. Success there suggested, mistakenly, the possibility of a worldwide species eradication using hunt-and-destroy campaigns and the killing power of the pesticide. In 1946 Soper and the Rockefeller Foundation embarked on a malaria campaign in Sardinia, designed to show that DDT could be used not just to control malaria, but to eliminate it. They sprayed the chemical from airplanes and helicopters and employed a total of twenty-four thousand men in ground teams, whose equipment included flame-throwers. Yet despite extending the campaign for five years, they failed to eradicate the mosquito. It was too well entrenched. Hundreds of thousands of pounds of DDT were spread over the Sardinian landscape, but tests showed that the mosquito larvae survived concentrations of the chemical twenty-five times greater than those used in the eradication campaign—for reasons no one could quite explain.
zh: 结果，疟疾专家从埃及得出了错误的教训。那里的成功使他们误以为，能够通过搜捕歼灭运动和杀虫剂的杀伤力，在全球根除一个物种。1946年，索珀与洛克菲勒基金会在撒丁岛启动抗疟运动，旨在表明DDT不仅可用于控制疟疾，还可以消除疟疾。他们用飞机和直升机喷洒药剂，地面队伍总共雇用了两万四千人，装备甚至包括火焰喷射器。然而，尽管运动持续了五年，他们还是未能根除蚊子。它已经扎根得太深。数十万磅DDT被撒向撒丁岛各地，但试验表明，蚊幼虫能在根除运动所用浓度二十五倍的药剂中存活，其原因无人能够完全解释。

en: Undeterred by this failure, four years later, in 1955, the World Health Organization (WHO), which had taken over responsibility for the worldwide administration of antimalarial campaigns from the Rockefeller Foundation, adopted a plan for the global eradication of malaria using DDT. Countries where the anopheles mosquito was relatively thinly established reduced or even eliminated the vector, especially in Europe, but in many more places eradication was not effective. Although described as “global,” the eradication program ignored Africa, the world’s major malarial region, aside from one or two pilot schemes. Elsewhere the parasite gradually developed resistance to quinine and other drugs and returned in large numbers.

Meanwhile, DDT produced other, more destructive effects. Only in 1969 did the WHO agree to move toward programs of vector management rather than eradication and begin to warn of the risks of DDT, leading to its banning (but not elimination), at least in agriculture. At the end of the 1990s the United Nations Environment Program sponsored negotiations to end the use of DDT altogether by 2007.
zh: 这次失败没有使他们退缩。四年后，即1955年，已经从洛克菲勒基金会接手全球抗疟运动管理责任的世界卫生组织（WHO），采纳了使用DDT在全球根除疟疾的计划。在按蚊分布相对稀疏的国家，疾病媒介数量减少，甚至被消除，欧洲尤其如此；但在更多地方，根除并未奏效。尽管被称为“全球”计划，这项根除计划除了一两个试点外，却忽略了世界上最主要的疟疾地区——非洲。在其他地方，寄生虫逐渐对奎宁和其他药物产生抗药性，并大规模卷土重来。
与此同时，DDT产生了其他更具破坏性的影响。直到1969年，世卫组织才同意转向媒介管理计划，而非根除计划，并开始警告DDT的风险，最终促成了至少在农业上的禁用，但并未使其绝迹。20世纪90年代末，联合国环境规划署推动谈判，拟在2007年前彻底停止使用DDT。
body.review: 这里的2007年是底本所述谈判目标，不表示该年已实现全球全面禁用。斯德哥尔摩公约秘书处将DDT列于附件B，在规定条件下仍保留病媒控制的可接受用途。

en: By this time there was a better understanding of DDT’s long-term effects. While almost insoluble in water, it dissolves easily in fat, so it accumulates in the fatty tissue of animals, an accumulation that is magnified through the food web. Although no one still quite knew how it worked, it was believed that it acts like a hormone, mimicking or disrupting chemical messengers in the body, affecting the development and functioning of the organism. It weakens the immune system, decreases lactation, causes male animals to develop female reproductive organs, and leads to other disruptions of sexual development.
zh: 到这时，人们对DDT的长期影响已有了更多理解。它虽然几乎不溶于水，却很容易溶于脂肪，因此会在动物脂肪组织中累积，并经食物网逐级放大。尽管仍没有人完全知道它如何起作用，但人们认为，它会像激素一样，模仿或扰乱体内的化学信使，影响有机体的发育与功能。它削弱免疫系统、减少泌乳，使雄性动物发育出雌性生殖器官，并造成其他性发育紊乱。

en: Since these powers were not limited to killing the lice, clothes moths, and mosquitoes for which DDT had been developed, its use quickly spread to other areas, especially agriculture. Far more of the pesticide was used worldwide in farming, to support the increased use of synthetic fertilizers, than in public health programs. One of the most popular worldwide applications was in the protection of cotton crops.
zh: 由于这些力量并不限于杀死当初开发DDT所针对的虱子、衣蛾和蚊子，它的用途迅速扩展到其他领域，尤其是农业。世界范围内，为配合合成肥料使用的增加，农业使用这种杀虫剂的数量，远远超过公共卫生计划中的用量。其中最普遍的应用之一，就是保护棉花作物。

en: In Egypt, by 1950 the use of chemical fertilizers had returned to their prewar levels, the highest in the world. The fertilizers were producing “lush vegetation and flowering,” it was reported, which encouraged insect pests, in particular the cotton leaf worm.
Two local companies began importing DDT to combat the cotton pest. With U.S. help the government acquired the six helicopters from United Helicopters to use for spraying the chemical from the air.
zh: 在埃及，到1950年，化肥使用量已经恢复到战前水平，仍为世界最高。据报告，肥料造成“植株繁茂、开花旺盛”，因而助长了害虫，尤其是棉叶虫。
两家本地公司开始进口DDT，以对付这种棉花害虫。在美国帮助下，政府从联合直升机公司购入了那六架直升机，用于从空中喷洒药剂。

en: Meanwhile, the country’s two dominant business monopolies, the ʿAbbud and Misr groups, whose increasing power I mentioned earlier, consolidated their control by forming a political and economic alliance, which in 1950 helped bring the Wafd party back to power. The two groups prepared the way for this collaboration a year earlier by agreeing to coinvest in a new joint venture with the U.S. chemical company Monsanto—to build a local plant to manufacture DDT.

A major ingredient of DDT is ethyl alcohol, which was to be made by Egypt’s only commercial distillery, the Société Egyptienne de Distillerie, owned by the sugar baron Ahmad ʿAbbud, using molasses supplied by his sugar monopoly.

ʿAbbud had got rich helping to build the Aswan Dam, which enabled the spread of sugar plantations but also required the introduction of fertilizer. The use of fertilizers brought insect pests, which needed treatment with DDT. Now the DDT would be made from ʿAbbud’s sugar.
zh: 与此同时，前文提到权力不断增长的两大垄断企业集团——阿布德集团和米斯尔集团——通过结成政治经济联盟巩固了控制，并于1950年帮助华夫脱党重新执政。一年前，两集团同意共同投资，与美国化学公司孟山都建立一家新的合资企业，在当地建厂生产DDT，为这次合作铺平了道路。
DDT的一种主要原料是乙醇，将由埃及唯一的商业酿馏厂——埃及蒸馏公司（Société Egyptienne de Distillerie）——制造；该厂属于糖业大亨艾哈迈德·阿布德，使用其糖业垄断企业提供的糖蜜。
阿布德靠参与兴建阿斯旺大坝发了财；大坝使甘蔗种植园得以扩张，却也要求引入肥料。肥料使用带来了害虫，需要用DDT处理。而如今，DDT又将由阿布德的糖来制造。

en: By the time of Nasser’s military coup two years later, the government had decided to build the pesticide factory itself using the assistance of international healthcare agencies. One week after the coup, on August 2, 1952, in perhaps its first international act, the new government signed an agreement with WHO and UNICEF to build a factory at Kafr Zayat that would produce two hundred tons a year of finished DDT.

With healthcare agencies financing this mass production of the new pesticide, the U.S. Embassy was able to report with optimism that while “Egypt consumes at present less pesticides than would be the case if the average farmer were better educated,” as his education progressed, “increased demand for such products should develop.”

Demand did indeed develop. Standard doses of pesticide were soon found to be ineffective. The DDT had been killing off natural predators, so the pests that survived the chemical were able to reproduce explosively. The quantities used had to be doubled and then trebled. Without the government having to spend a penny on further education for farmers, but through the working of the chemical’s own poorly understood powers, the use of pesticides progressed.
zh: 两年后，纳赛尔发动军事政变时，政府已经决定借助国际卫生机构的援助，自行兴建杀虫剂工厂。政变一周后，即1952年8月2日，新政府在可能是其第一次国际行动中，与世卫组织及联合国儿童基金会签署协议，在卡夫尔扎亚特建厂，每年生产二百吨DDT成品。
有卫生机构出资大规模生产这种新杀虫剂，美国使馆便能乐观地报告：尽管“埃及目前的杀虫剂消费量，低于普通农民受到更好教育时本可达到的水平”，但随着教育程度提高，“对这些产品的需求应当增长”。
需求果然增长了。人们很快发现，标准剂量的杀虫剂已不起作用。DDT一直在杀死自然天敌，于是在药剂作用下存活的害虫得以爆发式繁殖。用量不得不先翻倍，再增至三倍。政府无需为农民的进一步教育花一分钱，杀虫剂的使用便通过这种化学品自身尚未被充分理解的力量不断推进。

en: Today the

has disappeared from the story of Egyptian politics. Even the one good account we have of the malaria epidemic, by Nancy Gallagher, does not give the mosquito or its parasite much credit. As in every other explanation of this kind of politics, history has a limited number of actors, and the insect arriving from the south is not one of them. There are the British, manipulating Egyptian politics while resisting the incipient postwar usurpation of their role by Americans; there are the national elites—the monarchy and the small landed aristocracy—losing their power to a more dynamic class of commercial landowners, entrepreneurs, and military officers; and, now and again, there are the subaltern communities—the rural population, the urban working classes, women—making up the rest of the social order. The mosquito, on the other hand, is said to belong to nature. It cannot speak.
zh: 如今，冈比亚按蚊已经从埃及政治的故事中消失。甚至我们拥有的那部有关疟疾疫情的出色叙述——南希·加拉格尔的著作——也没有给蚊子或它的寄生虫多少功劳。和对这类政治的其他一切解释一样，历史中的行动者数量有限，而从南方到来的昆虫并不在其中。有英国人，一面操纵埃及政治，一面抵抗美国人在战后开始取代其角色；有民族精英——君主制与人数不多的土地贵族——其权力逐渐落入更具活力的商业地主、企业家和军官阶层手中；偶尔，还有底层社群——乡村人口、城市工人阶级、妇女——构成社会秩序的其余部分。蚊子却被说成属于自然。它不能说话。

en: As part of nature, the gambiae mosquito became a problem of public health. With the mosquito’s help, questions of hygiene, disease, housing, and ignorance emerged as the principal way of addressing the situation of rural Egypt. National politics was organized around programs of health improvement, rural reconstruction, technical development, and above all the engineering of the river Nile and the transformation of its power into electricity, fertilizers, irrigation, and the growth of agriculture and manufacturing. The resources and limits of nature and, by extension, of rural society were to be transformed by the dynamic activity of technical development, which required the application of scientific and social scientific expertise.
zh: 作为自然的一部分，冈比亚按蚊成了公共卫生问题。在蚊子的帮助下，卫生、疾病、住房和无知这些问题，成为处理埃及乡村处境的主要方式。国家政治围绕改善健康、乡村重建、技术发展的计划展开，尤其围绕尼罗河的工程改造，以及把它的力量转化为电力、肥料、灌溉和农业与制造业增长的计划展开。自然的资源与限度，进而乡村社会的资源与限度，都将通过技术发展的能动活动而改变；而这要求运用科学和社会科学的专门知识。

en: These projects began to arrange the world as one in which science was opposed to nature and technical expertise claimed to overcome the obstacles to social improvement. The malaria eradication campaign presented an opportunity to bring the intelligence of medical science, with its resources of chemistry, hygiene, past experience, and worldwide information, to work upon the insect vectors, protozoan parasites, fevers, poverty, and malnutrition that made up the defects of the material world and had to be defeated. In irrigation projects, the power of technical assistance and engineering was to overcome the limits of natural resources. At al-Alamein, the first great battle of technicized warfare, two opposing generals, it is said, combined the mobile powers of mechanized weapons and the new, large-scale deployment of mines to determine the course of history. Such programs and campaigns manufactured a world that appeared as natural resources versus technology, bodies versus hygiene, men versus machines, the river versus human ingenuity.
zh: 这些项目开始把世界安排成这样一个世界：科学与自然相对立，技术专长声称能够克服社会改良的障碍。根除疟疾的运动提供了一个机会，让医学科学的智慧，连同其化学、卫生、过往经验和全球信息资源，作用于昆虫媒介、原生动物寄生虫、发热、贫困和营养不良；这些构成了物质世界的缺陷，必须被击败。在灌溉项目中，技术援助与工程的力量将克服自然资源的限制。在阿拉曼——技术化战争的第一场大战——据说，两名敌对的将军结合机械化武器的机动力与大规模布雷的新部署，决定了历史进程。这些计划与运动制造出一个世界，呈现为自然资源对技术、身体对卫生、人对机器、河流对人类才智。

en: Yet the projects that produced this binary world could emerge only by engaging a series of other logics, forces, and chemistries: the hydraulic energy of the Nile River, the chemical properties of ammonia, the feeding patterns of the anopheles mosquito, the career making of a Rockefeller epidemiologist, the supply lines sustaining an army at war, the reproductive cycle of the plasmodium parasite, the anticolonial struggle of Egyptian nationalism, the world’s increasing chemical addiction to sugar, and DDT’s preference for fatty tissue, to name a few. Although technical development portrayed the world as passive, as nature to be overcome or material resources to be developed, the relations of science and development came into being only by working with such forces.
zh: 然而，产生这个二元世界的项目，只有调用一系列其他逻辑、力量和化学作用才能出现：尼罗河的水力能量、氨的化学性质、按蚊的摄食模式、洛克菲勒体系中一位流行病学家的职业经营、维系战时军队的补给线、疟原虫的繁殖周期、埃及民族主义的反殖民斗争、世界对糖日益增长的化学性依赖，以及DDT对脂肪组织的偏好——这里只列举了其中一些。尽管技术发展把世界描绘成被动的，描绘成有待克服的自然或有待开发的物质资源，但科学与发展的关系，只有与这些力量一道工作才能形成。

en: The same was true of what was called the development of capitalism. The circuits that ʿAbbud tried to control and transform into sources of profit involved family networks, the properties of sugar and nitrates, the labor of those harvesting cane, imperial connections, and the shortages brought by war. The production of profit, or surplus value, came about only by working within and transforming such other forces and reserves. Thus a term like “capitalist development” covers a series of agencies, logics, chain reactions, and contingent interactions, among which the specific circuits and relations of capital formed only a part.
zh: 所谓资本主义的发展，也是如此。阿布德试图控制并转化为利润来源的回路，涉及家族网络、糖和硝酸盐的性质、收割甘蔗者的劳动、帝国关系，以及战争带来的短缺。只有在这些其他力量与储备之中运作，并使其转变，利润或剩余价值的生产才会发生。因此，“资本主义发展”这样的用语，涵盖了一系列能动作用、逻辑、连锁反应与偶然互动；资本自身特定的回路与关系，只构成其中一部分。

en: Introducing these other forces is not a question of describing the resistance of nature or material conditions. It is not a matter of acknowledging nonhuman forces that worked against human expertise or created obstacles to technical progress and capitalist development. The reports describing the problems of the Aswan Dam, the setbacks in malaria eradication, or the failure of technical assistance programs often used such formulations to express the difficult relationship between human intention and the world of experience. Expertise, however, did not confront such resistance externally, after it was already complete, nor did the power of capital. Plans, intentions, scientific expertise, techno-power, and surplus value were created in combination with these other forces or elements. The technology of dam construction was formed at the construction site in Aswan, and in earlier and subsequent projects. The methods of mosquito eradication developed in Brazil and Egypt were the outcome of working with

in particular locations, among a new population of human hosts. What is called nature or the material world moves, like the plasmodium, in and out of human forms, or occurs as arrangements, like the river Nile, that are social as well as natural, technical as well as material. The world out of which techno-politics emerged was an unresolved and prior combination of reason, force, imagination, and resources. Ideas and technology did not precede this mixture as pure forms of thought brought to bear upon the messy world of reality. They emerged from the mixture and were manufactured in the processes themselves.
zh: 引入这些其他力量，并不是要描述自然或物质条件的抵抗，也不是要承认那些对抗人类专门知识、或阻碍技术进步与资本主义发展的非人力量。描述阿斯旺大坝的问题、根除疟疾的挫折，或技术援助计划失败的报告，常常用这类说法来表达人的意图与经验世界之间的艰难关系。然而，专门知识并不是先已完整形成，然后才在外部遭遇这种抵抗；资本的力量也不是。计划、意图、科学专门知识、技术权力和剩余价值，都是与这些其他力量或要素结合而创造出来的。筑坝技术形成于阿斯旺工地，也形成于此前和此后的工程。巴西与埃及发展出的灭蚊方法，是在特定地点、在一群新的人类宿主之中同冈比亚按蚊打交道的结果。所谓自然或物质世界，像疟原虫一样进出于人的形态之中，或者像尼罗河一样，作为同时具有社会性与自然性、技术性与物质性的安排而存在。技术政治从中涌现的世界，是理性、力量、想象和资源一种先在而未获化解的组合。观念与技术并非先于这种混合物而存在，再以纯粹思想的形式作用于混乱的现实世界。它们从混合物中涌现，并在过程本身之中被制造出来。

en: Resolving these processes into reason versus force, intelligence versus nature, or the imagined versus the real misapprehends the complexity. But this misapprehension was necessary, for it was exactly how the production of techno-power proceeded. Overlooking the mixed way things happen, indeed producing the effect of neatly separate realms of reason and the real world, ideas and their objects, the human and the nonhuman, was how power was coming to work in Egypt, and in the twentieth century in general.
zh: 把这些过程归结为理性对力量、智识对自然，或想象对实在，会误解其中的复杂性。但这种误解又是必要的，因为技术权力的生产恰恰如此进行。忽视事情以混合方式发生，甚至制造出理性与现实世界、观念与其对象、人和非人分属整齐分隔领域的效果，正是权力在埃及、乃至整个20世纪开始发挥作用的方式。

en: Social science, by relating particular events to a universal reason and by treating human agency as given, mimics this form of power. The normal methods of analysis end up reproducing this kind of power, taken in by the effects it generates. In fact, social science helps to format a world resolved into this binary order, and thus to constitute and solidify the experience of agency and expertise. In much of social science this is quite deliberate. It tries to acquire the kind of intellectual mastery of social processes that dams seem to offer over rivers, artificial nitrates over sugarcane production, or DDT over arthropods. It is less important whether one understands how things work, more important how effective are the immediate results. But more careful forms of historical or cultural analysis can do the same thing in less obvious ways, by leaving technics unexamined, or talking about the “social construction” of things that are clearly more than social.
zh: 社会科学通过把特定事件同普遍理性联系起来，并把人类能动性视为既定事实，模仿了这种权力形式。常规分析方法最终受它所制造的效果迷惑，再生产了这种权力。事实上，社会科学帮助把世界格式化为这种二元秩序，从而构成并巩固人们对能动性与专门知识的体验。在社会科学的许多领域，这完全是有意为之。它试图在智识上掌握社会过程，就像大坝似乎能够掌握河流、人工硝酸盐似乎能够掌握甘蔗生产、DDT似乎能够掌握节肢动物一样。是否理解事物如何运作，变得不那么重要；眼前结果是否有效，反而更重要。但更为审慎的历史或文化分析，也可能以不那么明显的方式做同样的事：不去审视技术，或把那些显然不止是社会性的事物，说成是“社会建构”的。

en: To put in question these distinctions, and the assumptions about agency and history that they make possible, does not mean introducing a limitless number of actors and networks, all of which are somehow of equal significance and power. Rather, it means making this issue of power and agency a question, instead of an answer known in advance. It means acknowledging something of the unresolvable tension, the inseparable mixture, the impossible multiplicity, out of which intention and expertise must emerge. It requires acknowledging that human agency, like capital, is a technical body, is something made. Instead of invoking the force and logic of reason, self-interest, science, or capital and attributing what happens in the world to the working of these enchanted powers and processes, we can open up the question, as I have attempted here, of what kinds of hybrid agencies, connections, interactions, and forms of violence are able to portray their actions as history, as human expertise overcoming nature, as the progress of reason and modernity, or as the expansion and development of capitalism.
zh: 质疑这些区分，以及它们使之成为可能的关于能动性与历史的预设，并不意味着要引入无限多的行动者和网络，并把它们都视为具有同等意义和力量。相反，这意味着让权力和能动性本身成为问题，而不是预先已知的答案。这意味着承认某种无法化解的张力、不可分割的混合、难以成立却又存在的多重性，意图和专门知识必须从中涌现。它要求承认，人类能动性同资本一样，是一种技术性构成体，是被制造出来的东西。我们不必援引理性、自利、科学或资本的力量和逻辑，把世界上发生的事情归因于这些被赋予魔力的力量与过程的运作；而可以像我在此尝试的那样，打开这样一个问题：究竟是哪些混合的能动作用、联结、互动与暴力形式，能够把自己的行动描绘成历史，描绘成人类专门知识克服自然、理性与现代性的进步，或资本主义的扩张与发展？

en: My account of ʿAbbud is drawn largely from Vitalis’s fine revisionist study of Egyptian business and politics in this period, based upon the case of ʿAbbud. The government took control of ʿAbbud’s business empire in a series of nationalizations between 1955 and 1963. It seized the remainder of the Armant estate in October 1961, when it sequestered the property of 168 “reactionary capitalists.” ʿAbbud died in London in December 1963 (Vitalis,
210–14). I visited the estate in 1997, by which time the last sequestration had been reversed and some of the property returned.
zh: 我对阿布德的叙述，主要取自维塔利斯以阿布德为个案、研究这一时期埃及商业与政治的出色修正主义著作。1955至1963年，政府通过一系列国有化措施接管了阿布德的商业帝国。1961年10月，政府查封168名“反动资本家”的财产时，没收了阿尔曼特庄园的剩余部分。阿布德于1963年12月在伦敦去世（Vitalis，《当资本家发生冲突》，第210—214页）。我1997年访问该庄园时，最后一次查封已被撤销，部分财产已经归还。

en: The 1952 agrarian reform law laid down that “no person may own more than 200 acres of land,” but allowed owners to keep another 100 acres by giving up to 50 acres to each of two children.
